+ import { getXataClient, type PersonnelRecord } from "../xata";
+ 
+ export type PersonnelInput = {
+ 	bio?: string;
+ 	role?: string;
+ 	photo?: string[];
+ 	rank?: number;
+ 	credibility?: number;
+ 	popularity?: number;
+ 	name: string;
+ 	authority?: number;
+ 	embedding?: number[];
+ };
+ 
+ export type PersonnelUpdateInput = Partial&lt;PersonnelInput&gt; &amp; {
+ 	id: string;
+ };
+ 
+ export async function getPersonnelById(
+ 	id: string,
+ ): Promise&lt;PersonnelRecord | null&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	return await xata.db.personnel.read(id);
+ }
+ 
+ export async function getAllPersonnel(options?: {
+ 	filter?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;
+ 	sort?: { column: string; direction: "asc" | "desc" }[];
+ 	page?: number;
+ 	size?: number;
+ }): Promise&lt;{
+ 	records: PersonnelRecord[];
+ 	pagination: { hasNextPage: boolean; total?: number };
+ }&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	const { filter, sort, page = 1, size = 50 } = options || {};
+ 
+ 	let query = xata.db.personnel.filter(filter || {});
+ 
+ 	if (sort?.length) {
+ 		for (const { column, direction } of sort) {
+ 			query = query.sort(column, direction);
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	const result = await query.getPaginated({
+ 		pagination: { size, offset: (page - 1) * size },
+ 	});
+ 
+ 	return {
+ 		records: result.records,
+ 		pagination: {
+ 			hasNextPage: result.hasNextPage,
+ 			total: result.pagination?.total,
+ 		},
+ 	};
+ }
+ 
+ export async function createPersonnel(
+ 	data: PersonnelInput,
+ ): Promise&lt;PersonnelRecord&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	return await xata.db.personnel.create(data);
+ }
+ 
+ export async function updatePersonnel({
+ 	id,
+ 	...data
+ }: PersonnelUpdateInput): Promise&lt;PersonnelRecord | null&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	return await xata.db.personnel.update(id, data);
+ }
+ 
+ export async function deletePersonnel(id: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	await xata.db.personnel.delete(id);
+ }
+ 
+ export async function searchPersonnel(
+ 	query: string,
+ 	limit = 10,
+ ): Promise&lt;PersonnelRecord[]&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	const results = await xata.search.all(query, {
+ 		tables: [{ table: "personnel", target: ["name", "bio", "role"] }],
+ 		fuzziness: 1,
+ 		prefix: "phrase",
+ 		limit,
+ 	});
+ 
+ 	return results.records as PersonnelRecord[];
+ }
+ 
```

+ }

+ export async function getAllSightings(options?: {
+ 	filter?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;
+ 	sort?: { column: string; direction: "asc" | "desc" }[];
+ 	page?: number;
+ 	size?: number;

+ 	pagination: { hasNextPage: boolean; total?: number };
+ }&gt; {

+ 	const { filter, sort, page = 1, size = 50 } = options || {};
+ 
+ 	let query = xata.db.sightings.filter(filter || {});
+

+ 		for (const { column, direction } of sort) {
+ 			query = query.sort(column, direction);
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	const result = await query.getPaginated({
+ 		pagination: { size, offset: (page - 1) * size },
+ 	});
+ 
+ 	return {
+ 		records: result.records,
+ 		pagination: {
+ 			hasNextPage: result.hasNextPage,
+ 			total: result.pagination?.total,
+ 		},
+ 	};
+ }
+ 
+ export async function createSighting(
+ 	data: SightingInput,
+ ): Promise&lt;SightingsRecord&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	return await xata.db.sightings.create(data);
+ }
+ 
+ export async function updateSighting({
+ 	id,
+ 	...data
+ }: SightingUpdateInput): Promise&lt;SightingsRecord | null&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	return await xata.db.sightings.update(id, data);
+ }
+ 
+ export async function deleteSighting(id: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	await xata.db.sightings.delete(id);
+ }
+ 
+ export async function searchSightings(
+ 	query: string,
+ 	limit = 10,
+ ): Promise&lt;SightingsRecord[]&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	const results = await xata.search.all(query, {
+ 		tables: [
+ 			{
+ 				table: "sightings",
+ 				target: [
+ 					"description",
+ 					"comments",
+ 					"city",
+ 					"state",
+ 					"country",
+ 					"shape",
+ 				],
+ 			},
+ 		],
+ 		fuzziness: 1,
+ 		prefix: "phrase",
+ 		limit,
+ 	});
+ 
+ 	return results.records as SightingsRecord[];
+ }
+ 
+ export async function getSightingsByLocation(
+ 	lat: number,
+ 	lng: number,
+ 	radiusKm: number,
+ ): Promise&lt;SightingsRecord[]&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 
+ 	// Convert radius from km to degrees (approximately)
+ 	// 1 degree of latitude = ~111 km, 1 degree of longitude varies with latitude
+ 	const latRadius = radiusKm / 111;
+ 	const lngRadius = radiusKm / (111 * Math.cos((lat * Math.PI) / 180));
+ 
+ 	const records = await xata.db.sightings
+ 		.filter({
+ 			latitude: { $ge: lat - latRadius, $le: lat + latRadius },
+ 			longitude: { $ge: lng - lngRadius, $le: lng + lngRadius },
+ 		})
+ 		.getAll();
+ 
+ 	// For more accurate radius filtering, we calculate actual distance
+ 	return records.filter((record) =&gt; {
+ 		if (record.latitude &amp;&amp; record.longitude) {
+ 			const distance = calculateDistance(
+ 				lat,
+ 				lng,
+ 				record.latitude,
+ 				record.longitude,
+ 			);
+ 			return distance &lt;= radiusKm;
+ 		}
+ 		return false;
+ 	});
+ }
+ 
+ // Haversine formula to calculate distance between two points
+ function calculateDistance(
+ 	lat1: number,
+ 	lon1: number,
+ 	lat2: number,
+ 	lon2: number,
+ ): number {
+ 	const R = 6371; // Radius of the Earth in km
+ 	const dLat = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;
+ 	const dLon = ((lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI) / 180;
+ 	const a =
+ 		Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
+ 		Math.cos((lat1 * Math.PI) / 180) *
+ 			Math.cos((lat2 * Math.PI) / 180) *
+ 			Math.sin(dLon / 2) *
+ 			Math.sin(dLon / 2);
+ 	const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
+ 	return R * c;
+ }
+

+ 		for (const { column, direction } of sort) {
+ 			query = query.sort(column, direction);
+ 		}
+ 	}

+ 	const result = await query.getPaginated({

+ export async function findOrCreateUser(
+ 	userData: UserInput,
+ ): Promise&lt;UsersRecord&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 
+ 	// Try to find by email first
+ 	let user = await getUserByEmail(userData.email);
+ 
+ 	// If no user found and external_id is provided, try to find by external_id
+ 	if (!user &amp;&amp; userData.external_id) {
+ 		user = await getUserByExternalId(userData.external_id);
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	// If user exists, update their info
+ 	if (user) {
+ 		const updatedUser = await xata.db.users.update(user.id, {
+ 			name: userData.name || user.name,
+ 			photo: userData.photo || user.photo,
+ 			profile_image_url: userData.profile_image_url || user.profile_image_url,
+ 			external_id: userData.external_id || user.external_id,
+ 		});
+ 		return updatedUser!;
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	// Otherwise create a new user
+ 	return await createUser(userData);
+ }

+ export async function getAllLocations(options?: {
+ 	filter?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;
+ 	sort?: { column: string; direction: "asc" | "desc" }[];
+ 	page?: number;
+ 	size?: number;
+ }): Promise&lt;{
+ 	records: LocationsRecord[];
+ 	pagination: { hasNextPage: boolean; total?: number };
+ }&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	const { filter, sort, page = 1, size = 50 } = options || {};
+ 
+ 	let query = xata.db.locations.filter(filter || {});
+ 
+ 	if (sort?.length) {
+ 		for (const { column, direction } of sort) {
+ 			query = query.sort(column, direction);
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	const result = await query.getPaginated({
+ 		pagination: { size, offset: (page - 1) * size },
+ 	});
+ 
+ 	return {
+ 		records: result.records,
+ 		pagination: {
+ 			hasNextPage: result.hasNextPage,
+ 			total: result.pagination?.total,
+ 		},
+ 	};
+ }

+ ): Promise&lt;LocationsRecord&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	return await xata.db.locations.create(data);
+ }
+

+ 	id,
+ 	...data
+ }: LocationUpdateInput): Promise&lt;LocationsRecord | null&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	return await xata.db.locations.update(id, data);
+ }

+ 	await xata.db.locations.delete(id);
+ }

+ 	query: string,
+ 	limit = 10,
+ ): Promise&lt;LocationsRecord[]&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	const results = await xata.search.all(query, {
+ 		tables: [{ table: "locations", target: ["name", "city", "state"] }],
+ 		fuzziness: 1,
+ 		prefix: "phrase",
+ 		limit,
+ 	});
+ 
+ 	return results.records as LocationsRecord[];
+ }
+ 
+ export async function getLocationsByCoordinates(
+ 	lat: number,
+ 	lng: number,
+ 	radiusKm: number,
+ ): Promise&lt;LocationsRecord[]&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 
+ 	// Convert radius from km to degrees (approximately)
+ 	// 1 degree of latitude = ~111 km, 1 degree of longitude varies with latitude
+ 	const latRadius = radiusKm / 111;
+ 	const lngRadius = radiusKm / (111 * Math.cos((lat * Math.PI) / 180));
+ 
+ 	const records = await xata.db.locations
+ 		.filter({
+ 			latitude: { $ge: lat - latRadius, $le: lat + latRadius },
+ 			longitude: { $ge: lng - lngRadius, $le: lng + lngRadius },
+ 		})
+ 		.getAll();
+ 
+ 	// For more accurate radius filtering, we calculate actual distance
+ 	return records.filter((record) =&gt; {
+ 		if (record.latitude &amp;&amp; record.longitude) {
+ 			const distance = calculateDistance(
+ 				lat,
+ 				lng,
+ 				record.latitude,
+ 				record.longitude,
+ 			);
+ 			return distance &lt;= radiusKm;
+ 		}
+ 		return false;
+ 	});
+ }
+ 
+ // Haversine formula to calculate distance between two points
+ function calculateDistance(
+ 	lat1: number,
+ 	lon1: number,
+ 	lat2: number,
+ 	lon2: number,
+ ): number {
+ 	const R = 6371; // Radius of the Earth in km
+ 	const dLat = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;
+ 	const dLon = ((lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI) / 180;
+ 	const a =
+ 		Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
+ 		Math.cos((lat1 * Math.PI) / 180) *
+ 			Math.cos((lat2 * Math.PI) / 180) *
+ 			Math.sin(dLon / 2) *
+ 			Math.sin(dLon / 2);
+ 	const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
+ 	return R * c;
+ }
+

+ import { getXataClient, type PersonnelRecord } from "../xata";
+ 
+ export type PersonnelInput = {
+ 	bio?: string;
+ 	role?: string;
+ 	photo?: string[];
+ 	rank?: number;
+ 	credibility?: number;
+ 	popularity?: number;
+ 	name: string;
+ 	authority?: number;
+ 	embedding?: number[];
+ };
+ 
+ export type PersonnelUpdateInput = Partial&lt;PersonnelInput&gt; &amp; {
+ 	id: string;
+ };
+ 
+ export async function getPersonnelById(
+ 	id: string,
+ ): Promise&lt;PersonnelRecord | null&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	return await xata.db.personnel.read(id);
+ }
+ 
+ export async function getAllPersonnel(options?: {
+ 	filter?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;
+ 	sort?: { column: string; direction: "asc" | "desc" }[];
+ 	page?: number;
+ 	size?: number;
+ }): Promise&lt;{
+ 	records: PersonnelRecord[];
+ 	pagination: { hasNextPage: boolean; total?: number };
+ }&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	const { filter, sort, page = 1, size = 50 } = options || {};
+ 
+ 	let query = xata.db.personnel.filter(filter || {});
+ 
+ 	if (sort?.length) {
+ 		for (const { column, direction } of sort) {
+ 			query = query.sort(column, direction);
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	const result = await query.getPaginated({
+ 		pagination: { size, offset: (page - 1) * size },
+ 	});
+ 
+ 	return {
+ 		records: result.records,
+ 		pagination: {
+ 			hasNextPage: result.hasNextPage,
+ 			total: result.pagination?.total,
+ 		},
+ 	};
+ }
+ 
+ export async function createPersonnel(
+ 	data: PersonnelInput,
+ ): Promise&lt;PersonnelRecord&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	return await xata.db.personnel.create(data);
+ }
+ 
+ export async function updatePersonnel({
+ 	id,
+ 	...data
+ }: PersonnelUpdateInput): Promise&lt;PersonnelRecord | null&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	return await xata.db.personnel.update(id, data);
+ }
+ 
+ export async function deletePersonnel(id: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	await xata.db.personnel.delete(id);
+ }
+ 
+ export async function searchPersonnel(
+ 	query: string,
+ 	limit = 10,
+ ): Promise&lt;PersonnelRecord[]&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	const results = await xata.search.all(query, {
+ 		tables: [{ table: "personnel", target: ["name", "bio", "role"] }],
+ 		fuzziness: 1,
+ 		prefix: "phrase",
+ 		limit,
+ 	});
+ 
+ 	return results.records as PersonnelRecord[];
+ }
+ 
```

+ export async function getAllSightings(options?: {
+ 	filter?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;
+ 	sort?: { column: string; direction: "asc" | "desc" }[];
+ 	page?: number;
+ 	size?: number;
+ }): Promise&lt;{
+ 	records: SightingsRecord[];
+ 	pagination: { hasNextPage: boolean; total?: number };
+ }&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	const { filter, sort, page = 1, size = 50 } = options || {};
+ 
+ 	let query = xata.db.sightings.filter(filter || {});
+ 
+ 	if (sort?.length) {
+ 		for (const { column, direction } of sort) {
+ 			query = query.sort(column, direction);
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	const result = await query.getPaginated({
+ 		pagination: { size, offset: (page - 1) * size },
+ 	});
+ 
+ 	return {
+ 		records: result.records,
+ 		pagination: {
+ 			hasNextPage: result.hasNextPage,
+ 			total: result.pagination?.total,
+ 		},
+ 	};
+ }
+ 
+ export async function createSighting(
+ 	data: SightingInput,
+ ): Promise&lt;SightingsRecord&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	return await xata.db.sightings.create(data);
+ }
+ 
+ export async function updateSighting({
+ 	id,
+ 	...data
+ }: SightingUpdateInput): Promise&lt;SightingsRecord | null&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	return await xata.db.sightings.update(id, data);
+ }
+ 
+ export async function deleteSighting(id: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	await xata.db.sightings.delete(id);
+ }
+ 
+ export async function searchSightings(
+ 	query: string,
+ 	limit = 10,
+ ): Promise&lt;SightingsRecord[]&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	const results = await xata.search.all(query, {
+ 		tables: [
+ 			{
+ 				table: "sightings",
+ 				target: [
+ 					"description",
+ 					"comments",
+ 					"city",
+ 					"state",
+ 					"country",
+ 					"shape",
+ 				],
+ 			},
+ 		],
+ 		fuzziness: 1,
+ 		prefix: "phrase",
+ 		limit,
+ 	});
+ 
+ 	return results.records as SightingsRecord[];
+ }
+ 
+ export async function getSightingsByLocation(
+ 	lat: number,
+ 	lng: number,
+ 	radiusKm: number,
+ ): Promise&lt;SightingsRecord[]&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 
+ 	// Convert radius from km to degrees (approximately)
+ 	// 1 degree of latitude = ~111 km, 1 degree of longitude varies with latitude
+ 	const latRadius = radiusKm / 111;
+ 	const lngRadius = radiusKm / (111 * Math.cos((lat * Math.PI) / 180));
+ 
+ 	const records = await xata.db.sightings
+ 		.filter({
+ 			latitude: { $ge: lat - latRadius, $le: lat + latRadius },
+ 			longitude: { $ge: lng - lngRadius, $le: lng + lngRadius },
+ 		})
+ 		.getAll();
+ 
+ 	// For more accurate radius filtering, we calculate actual distance
+ 	return records.filter((record) =&gt; {
+ 		if (record.latitude &amp;&amp; record.longitude) {
+ 			const distance = calculateDistance(
+ 				lat,
+ 				lng,
+ 				record.latitude,
+ 				record.longitude,
+ 			);
+ 			return distance &lt;= radiusKm;
+ 		}
+ 		return false;
+ 	});
+ }
+ 
+ // Haversine formula to calculate distance between two points
+ function calculateDistance(
+ 	lat1: number,
+ 	lon1: number,
+ 	lat2: number,
+ 	lon2: number,
+ ): number {
+ 	const R = 6371; // Radius of the Earth in km
+ 	const dLat = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;
+ 	const dLon = ((lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI) / 180;
+ 	const a =
+ 		Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
+ 		Math.cos((lat1 * Math.PI) / 180) *
+ 			Math.cos((lat2 * Math.PI) / 180) *
+ 			Math.sin(dLon / 2) *
+ 			Math.sin(dLon / 2);
+ 	const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
+ 	return R * c;
+ }
+

+ 	return artifacts.length &gt; 0 ? artifacts[0] : null;

+ export async function getAllArtifacts(options?: {
+ 	filter?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;
+ 	sort?: { column: string; direction: "asc" | "desc" }[];
+ 	page?: number;
+ 	size?: number;
+ }): Promise&lt;{
+ 	records: ArtifactsRecord[];
+ 	pagination: { hasNextPage: boolean; total?: number };
+ }&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	const { filter, sort, page = 1, size = 50 } = options || {};
+ 
+ 	let query = xata.db.artifacts.filter(filter || {});
+ 
+ 	if (sort?.length) {
+ 		for (const { column, direction } of sort) {
+ 			query = query.sort(column, direction);
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	const result = await query.getPaginated({
+ 		pagination: { size, offset: (page - 1) * size },
+ 	});
+ 
+ 	return {
+ 		records: result.records,
+ 		pagination: {
+ 			hasNextPage: result.hasNextPage,
+ 			total: result.pagination?.total,
+ 		},

+ export async function searchArtifacts(
+ 	query: string,
+ 	limit = 10,
+ ): Promise&lt;ArtifactsRecord[]&gt; {
+ 	const xata = getXataClient();
+ 	const results = await xata.search.all(query, {
+ 		tables: [
+ 			{
+ 				table: "artifacts",
+ 				target: ["name", "description", "origin", "source"],
+ 			},
+ 		],
+ 		fuzziness: 1,
+ 		prefix: "phrase",
+ 		limit,
+ 	});
+ 
+ 	return results.records as ArtifactsRecord[];

+ 
+ export async function findOrCreateArtifact(
+ 	data: ArtifactInput,
+ ): Promise&lt;ArtifactsRecord&gt; {
+ 	const existing = await getArtifactByName(data.name);
+ 
+ 	if (existing) {
+ 		const updated = await updateArtifact({
+ 			id: existing.id,
+ 			...data,
+ 		});
+ 		return updated!;
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	return await createArtifact(data);
+ }

+ # Extracted Database Models
+ 
+ This directory contains Xata database models extracted from chat conversations. These files implement CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for the database tables in the Ultraterrestrial Resurrection project.
+ 
+ ## Files Extracted
+ 
+ 1. &#96;personnel.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the personnel table
+ 2. &#96;organizations.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the organizations table
+ 3. &#96;sightings.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the sightings table
+ 4. &#96;documents.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the documents table
+ 5. &#96;locations.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the locations table
+ 6. &#96;artifacts.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the artifacts table
+ 7. &#96;mindmaps.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the mindmaps table
+ 8. &#96;summary-files.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the summary-files table
+ 9. &#96;users.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the users table
+ 10. &#96;user-saved-items.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for various user-saved-* tables
+ 
+ ## Important Note
+ 
+ These files have import paths that need to be adjusted for your actual project structure. The current imports are:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { getXataClient, ... } from "../xata";
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ or in the client.ts file:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { XataClient } from "@/xata";
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ You may need to adjust these paths based on where these files are placed in your project.
+ 
+ ## Client.ts
+ 
+ The &#96;client.ts&#96; file was extracted from the history file &#96;2025-05-04_15-52-xata-client-import-vs-instantiation.md&#96;. It provides a singleton pattern for the Xata client that can be used in two ways:
+ 
+ 1. Importing and using the &#96;getXataClient()&#96; function to get the client instance
+ 2. Directly importing the &#96;xata&#96; instance which is initialized on module load
+ 
+ According to the history file, directly importing the client instance is slightly better in most cases for cleaner and more concise code.
+
